text_block_list.text:
One day, with Bamboo Memory's debut race
just around the cornerâ

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Please!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh, if it isn't Yaeno!
What a coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Yaeno Muteki. She practices martial arts, stoically trains every day, and is my slightly old-fashioned, cool classmate...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Good work, Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Are you here to practice as well?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's right! With my debut race coming up,
I just can't stop itching to run!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "Whenever things get like this, I always come here to practice and swing my bat to clear my head... Were you doing the same, Yaeno?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Likewise, I was borrowing this corner
in an effort to calm my mind.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I knew it!
Well then, let's both give it everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hup...! Hup...!
Hup...! Hup...!
100 more to go...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Ha! ...Sei!
...Hmph, haah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Phew! Worked up a great sweat, didn't we~!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Those were truly sharp swings, packed with fighting spirit.
I can feel your passion for your debut race."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Same to you, Yaeno! Thanks to you, I've got even more pumped up for my swings!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heheh—
I've been thinkin' this for a while, but...
we kinda have a lot in common, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Before, Yaeno, you said you
enter races seeking 'the strong,'
right?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A race against "formidable foes" against whom I can unleash the flames dwelling within me to my heart's content.
That is precisely what I seek on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Me too! My dream is to meet an insanely strong,
'ultimate rival' and have the ultimate showdown!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Doesn't that feel... kind of similar?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, in that sense,
we are both contenders taking on races in search of the "strongest," aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Totally, totally!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However, what Bamboo-san and I seek at the end of a battle against the "strong" might be a little different.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Mmh, the aftermath of battle...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To defeat the 'strong' who surpass me in mind, skill, and body, I must inevitably elevate my own mind, skill, and body to a realm beyond even theirs...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Part of the reason I challenge the 'strong'
is to better my inexperienced self through battle.
And that—"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"It is also a path to repay my grandparents, who guided me
with the Kongo Yaegaki style when I was nothing more
than an utterly violent roughneck."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To hone my mind and body through battles against the "strong", and repay the great debt I owe to my grandparents...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "That is what I desire at the end of this battle. To borrow Bamboo-san's words—"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It is my "dream."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And to be completely honest,
I'd love to face my grandfather as a fellow "warrior"
and score an ippon against him in martial arts someday, but...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That's a slightly different topic, though... Oh,
Bamboo-san, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ain't that a great "dream" now, huh~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's so hot! It really hit me in the heart!!
So cool, man!!! I'm so moved!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So for Yaeno, her grandfather is both her master and her rival! That's so ridiculously cool and fiery~~!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Grandpa... I mean, I've never really thought of my grandfather as a rival before.
...It feels a little refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even so, aren't you exaggerating a bit?
My trivial "dream" hardly deserves
such high praise—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No way, that's not true at all!!
Your "dream", Yaeno! It's genuinely wonderful!!
I'm gonna cheer you on with everything I've got!! So—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"When the day comes that we clash on the same track,
I promise I'll become a 'worthy rival' in Yaeno's eyes!!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Then I shall also strive
to become Bamboo-san's
'greatest rival.'"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And let us elevate each other to greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Are you for real?! Oooohhh!!
Now I'm all fired up~~~~!!
It's a promise, Yaeno!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
It's a promise.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—And so, that happened the other day~!!
Man, I was just so,
so deeply touched by it!!
choice_data_list: Looks like we've got another awesome rival candidate
Looks like we've got another awesome rival candidate, huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right! For today's training, I'm gonna give it my all and blaze right through it, ssir!!

Her debut race was just around the corner.
Bamboo Memory's fighting spirit burned with even greater intensity...!
